cancellation_semantics: A non-nil context is checked before validation, throughout source scans, geometry construction, scan conversion, coverage/composition and hashing, and immediately before publication. Cancellation never returns a Surface or Receipt.
composition: Composite each coverage-scaled path over the accumulated pixel in source path array order with the exact Porter-Duff source-over equation and single nearest-even quantization of cutly.compositor.cpu-kernel.v1.
coverage_quantization: For each path and pixel, multiply each premultiplied channel returned by the paint profile by the integer covered-sample count in [0,64], divide by 64, and round the complete rational once to nearest integer with exact half ties to even.
excluded_responsibilities: Document/timeline identity, asset lookup, clip timing, transforms, opacity, transitions, text shaping, strokes, curves, SVG/XML/CSS, external references, host DPI, output transfer conversion, encoding, persistence and publication are outside this package.
failure_semantics: Unsupported profiles, v1 features, strokes, cubic commands, malformed canonical rationals, invalid command state, resource overflow, exact-bit overflow, allocation failure and cancellation fail closed with a nil Surface and zero Receipt. There is no partial or lower-quality result.
fill_rules: nonzero accumulates signed directed crossings and is inside when the sum is nonzero; evenodd is inside after an odd number of crossings. Paths are fill-only, and source path array order is paint order.
geometry_mapping: Use exact rational xMidYMid meet: s=min(viewport_width/view_box_width,viewport_height/view_box_height), x=(viewport_width-s*view_box_width)/2+s*(source_x-view_box_x), y=(viewport_height-s*view_box_height)/2+s*(source_y-view_box_y). No float or host vector API is permitted.
ownership_semantics: Rasterize borrows the VectorSource object graph until return and callers must not mutate it concurrently. A successful Surface owns an immutable copy of all pixels, and Receipt contains no caller-owned mutable storage.
point_in_fill: Cast a ray from each sample toward +x. An edge crosses only when sample_y is in its lower-inclusive upper-exclusive y interval and crossing_x is strictly greater than sample_x; horizontal and degenerate edges never cross. Consequently an axis-aligned rectangle is top/left inclusive and bottom/right exclusive.
resource_semantics: Before output allocation, validate dimensions, pixel/path/command/conceptual-edge counts, canonical-source upper bound, exact-integer bit bounds, retained bytes, logical temporary working bytes and overflow-checked conservative work units. Working accounting includes canonicalization, pixel staging, one reusable coverage plane and exact geometry/event/crossing storage; it excludes caller storage and the separately bounded retained Surface.
sampling: Every output pixel uses exactly 64 equally weighted samples at (x+(2*i+1)/16,y+(2*j+1)/16) for i,j in [0,7]. There is no adaptive sampling, jitter or platform-dependent antialiasing.
source_hash_semantics: SHA-256 over the complete validated VectorSource serialized as canonical JSON: recursively lexicographic object keys, source array order, no insignificant whitespace, base-10 model integers and standard JSON string escaping; encode as lowercase hex with the sha256: prefix. Profile, viewBox, viewport, path IDs, commands, fill rules and paints are included. Conceptual closure edges are not inserted.
subpath_closure: move_to starts a subpath. A still-open subpath is conceptually closed by one straight edge when the next move_to begins or the path ends; close adds that edge immediately. Conceptual edges do not alter canonical source bytes.
viewport_coordinates: The declared raster viewport is top-down square-pixel edge coordinates: x in [0,width] and y in [0,height]. Samples outside the viewport are clipped and uncovered letterbox pixels remain transparent.
